answer.value: Pretraining on ~40 trillion tokens of multimodal data (Llama 4 Scout) from publicly available, licensed data and Meta product/service information; followed by safety fine-tuning using human-generated data from vendors combined with synthetic data. The card gives no detail on SFT, DPO, RL, distillation or merging stages.
quotes: Llama 4 Scout was pretrained on ~40 trillion tokens and Llama 4 Maverick was pretrained on ~22 trillion tokens of multimodal data from a mix of publicly available, licensed data and information from Meta’s products and services.
We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.

The primary objective of conducting safety fine-tuning is to offer developers a readily available, safe, and powerful model for various applications, reducing the workload needed to deploy safe AI systems.
